summary.text: Great Strength True Martial Physique is one of the ten extreme physiques. Holders gain extreme strength path amplification, and successful immortal ascension yields a super grade blessed land.

claims.text: Hei Bai names the ten extreme physique Great Strength True Martial on Hei Lou Lan while talking with Hei Cheng in Xiao Hun blessed land, reading the adoption by Fairy Jiang Yu as a way to preserve Hei Lou Lan’s life through Immortal Gu Dark Limit. Hei Cheng says the physique needs a strength path Immortal Gu to advance to Gu Immortal realm, and that Hei tribe has none.
Broader set rules sit on Ten Extreme Physique.

Facing the flying bear phantom, Hei Lou Lan judges that dark path methods alone will not finish the fight, but strength path abilities amplified by Great Strength True Martial Physique could kill it. Using those methods would break Dark Limit’s sealing effect and hasten the ten extreme physique disaster.
He is of that ten extreme physique and needs a strength path Immortal Gu to ascend and escape the threat of death.
Hei Cheng later confirms Hei Lou Lan has one of the ten extreme physiques and says she has lived until now because he asked Jiang Yu to protect her life.

Chasing Tai Bai Yun Sheng, Hei Lou Lan drops Dark Limit’s seal and unleashes the physique outright, nearing self-detonation as her battle strength spikes enough to suppress a Gu Immortal. Fang Yuan judges the aura is extremely likely Great Strength True Martial Physique before Tai Bai Yun Sheng can answer.
Fairy Jiang Yu had used Dark Limit Immortal Gu to conceal her ten extreme physique aura completely up to that point, keeping heaven’s will from sensing it.

During the Imperial Court stretch, Hei Lou Lan possesses Great Strength True Martial Physique of the ten extreme physiques. In the legends, Gu Masters with that physique have immense strength, stamina that never runs out, and extremely astonishing self recovery. Any strength path killer move under that physique erupts far past its usual strength.

Giant Sun’s will hands Hei Lou Lan a strength path Immortal Gu and orders the dark limit seal released so the true might of the ten extreme physique can show. The will states that Great Strength True Martial Physique has the highest recovery speed in the world, greatly surpassing the other nine extreme physiques, and promises rescue even if Hei Lou Lan self-detonates.
Its recovery ability sits at the top of the ten extreme physiques, tens of times stronger than six arm heavenly zombie king.

The physique’s immortal ascension draws a heavenly tribulation and earthly calamity far past an ordinary Gu Immortal’s, by Tai Bai Yun Sheng’s estimate at least a dozen times as terrifying, and Hei Lou Lan sacrifices divert disaster Immortal Gu and a pair of her eyes to survive it.
After Hei Lou Lan succeeds in becoming an immortal, Fairy Li Shan states that with Great Strength True Martial Physique she possesses a super grade blessed land and extraordinary potential.

Fang Yuan concludes that using a Great Strength True Martial Physique immortal zombie body in life-and-death immortal aperture revival would yield a super grade blessed land and leave the revived holder with that physique. He ties the point to Hei Lou Lan’s own super grade blessed land after ascending with the physique, and names that immortal zombie body his optimal target among available options.

Yi Tian Mountain hides the Immortal Gu House Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage and the rank eight Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie, and the Immortal Gu House suppresses him with a strength that seeps out to make the forbidden zone for immortals. That rank eight immortal zombie possesses Great Strength True Martial Physique, but his main cultivation is wisdom path. Unwilling to be suppressed, he used a killer move that tried to refine the Immortal Gu House with his battle will and did not succeed, his soul dying thoroughly and leaving an empty shell of a body. Large quantities of his battle will stay inside the Immortal Gu House, purified by its strength into pure ownerless battle will.
At Yi Tian Mountain, the rank eight Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie breaks free of Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage’s suppression, then is destroyed by a beam from Heaven Overseeing Tower.

That escape and destruction belong to Fang Yuan’s previous life, and at this point in this life the immortal zombie is still suppressed by Fang Yuan and cannot budge, so Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord waits rather than moving at once.

In Fang Yuan’s assessment, the rank eight Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie had strong strength path talent and gave it up to cultivate wisdom path instead. Fang Yuan knows that the immortal zombie’s wisdom path method is what lets him dig a way out of a situation of certain loss.

The delay lets the rank eight Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie break free of Fang Yuan’s suppression and recover. When Ying Wu Xie flies out of the ten extreme immortal zombie lifeless formation, the freed immortal zombie takes over his spot. He laughs that he faces such a great enemy after so many years of suppression, then points at Heaven Overseeing Tower and shouts for Heavenly Court to come celebrate his resurrection.

Fang Yuan remembers that the immortal zombie had already been vaporized by Heaven Overseeing Tower before that tower’s strike forced his own last activation of Spring Autumn Cicada, which failed. Reading that destruction through Sixth Hair’s explanation, Fang Yuan takes it as leaving the ten extreme immortal zombie lifeless formation incomplete and unable to refine Gu, so Shadow Sect’s plan failed and heaven’s will no longer needed him as its tool. In that same reading the only other way to complete the formation was Hei Lou Lan, and she was not at Yi Tian Mountain.
That Great Strength True Martial Physique immortal zombie is Da Li, a rare cultivator of both wisdom and strength path who left no Regret Pool insignia when refining strength path Immortal Gu.
Immortal zombie Da Li is a second generation split soul of Spectral Soul, Martial Duel Heavenly King, cultivating strength path and wisdom path together with Great Strength True Martial Physique.

Inside Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven, Blue Phoenix Tribe elders treat Hei Lou Lan’s dark capital strength tiger totem as proof of the sacred physique. Hei Lou Lan reads that sacred physique as her Great Strength True Martial Physique, and understands Immortal Zombie Giant Sun sent her there because the physique is really useful in that grotto-heaven. Lu Tong Lan says the rumor is that Reckless Savage Demon Venerable has Great Strength True Martial Physique, and that nobody can confirm whether the rumor is true.
